_comment: Photographs used on the site. Every entry was opened and checked by eye before use — a filename and a search term are not evidence of what an image shows. Attribution is a licence condition: author, licence and source page must stay with the image wherever it appears. Rejected candidates and why they were rejected are recorded below so the same mistakes are not repeated.

images.want: High-voltage transmission towers or lines on open prairie
images.title: 2018-08-18 HVDC WATL from Queen Elizabeth II Highway 0394.jpg
images.author: TagaSanPedroAko
images.description: Tower of the high-voltage direct current Western Alberta Transmission Line as seen from Alberta Highway 2
images.caption: The Western Alberta Transmission Line. Transmission capacity, not land, is the binding constraint on data centre development in Alberta.
images.reviewNote: Opened and checked by eye before use.

images.title: Altalink Langdon 102S Substation (31767566052).jpg
images.author: Tonyglen14 from Lethbridge, Alberta, Canada
images.caption: AltaLink’s Langdon 102S substation, Alberta. A connection of this kind is approved provincially, not by the municipality — which is why the two site plans have to be reconciled early.
images.reviewNote: Opened and checked by eye before use.

images.want: Alberta rural or agricultural land, the setting these sites occupy
images.title: Rural Alberta, Canada.jpg
images.author: Esther Lee
images.description: Flat prairie  farmlands exist for miles and miles in Alberta before encountering the jagged peaks of the Canadian Rockies.  This was taken outside of Calgary.
images.caption: Rural Alberta. The land these projects occupy, and the setting every siting decision starts from.
images.reviewNote: Opened and checked by eye before use.

images.want: Power generation in Alberta — gas plant, wind or solar
images.title: Windmills in Southern Alberta (2319508833).jpg
images.author: dave_7 from Lethbridge, Canada
images.caption: Wind generation in southern Alberta. Projects that bring their own generation sit outside the interim connection cap.
images.reviewNote: Opened and checked by eye before use.

rejected.why: Wikimedia returned NASA buildings and an airport car park for every data centre search. None depict a data centre. Commons has no usable free-licensed data centre photography under these terms.
A scanned page from a 1900s survey book, not a photograph.
Manitoba, not Alberta. Passing it off as Alberta would be exactly the kind of quiet inaccuracy this site exists to avoid.
Genuine industrial cooling towers, but at a Belgian chemical plant and unspecified sites. On a planning page a reader could reasonably take them for a local data centre installation.
Duplicates of a kept image, or not reviewed; dropped to keep the repository small.
